mapping.summary: AI reads emailed PDF sales orders and creates matched BC sales orders
claims: Reads and interprets incoming sales order PDFs with AI
Uses Anthropic Claude via MCP tools
Identifies the customer from VAT ID, name, address or email domain
Matches lines to items by EAN, GTIN, customer, vendor or manufacturer item number, or description
No per-customer templates or mapping rules needed
Price and quantity tolerances decide when orders convert automatically
Uncertain documents wait in a staging area with a PDF preview
Links posted invoices and shipments back to the original PDF
Includes role center, FactBoxes and standard permission sets
Localized for Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Germany, Austria and W1
Aimed at wholesalers, distributors and importers receiving PDF orders by email
